I am now checking whether p2 or p3 could threaten p4 through trades. p3 lacks the properties needed to build a complete color set. p2 cannot afford to unmortgage Park Place and build houses, since that would leave only $20 after paying the $192 unmortgage fee.

I calculated the exact cost to build a hotel on Boardwalk. Five houses plus the $192 unmortgage fee totals roughly $1192. p2 only has $212, so he cannot afford it alone. Even three houses would require about $792, which I do not have either.

I cannot fund p2 into a meaningful threat. One house on Boardwalk plus the unmortgage fee costs $392, but I only have $279. Receiving dark blue from p2 would also be risky: I could not build enough to threaten p4, and giving p2 my blockers might let him flip them to p4.

I considered trading for p3's cash, but his blockers are more valuable than money and utilities are not game-changing. I will end my turn without trading or mortgaging.

I am now considering a coordinated trade with p3 to create a direct threat against p4. I am also weighing whether to end my turn immediately, since I have already moved and this is the optional actions phase.

I cannot form a verbal alliance without proposing an actual trade. I considered buying Indiana from p2 and Illinois from p3 to complete the red set, but that would require taking Kentucky from p4, which is impossible. I also checked whether I could acquire the green set by trading for Pacific, Pennsylvania, and NC, but p4 already owns Pennsylvania, p3 owns Pacific, and p2 owns NC.

I cannot complete any color set without trading with p4. The orange set is already fully owned but remains unmortgaged and unbuildable. Dark blue, utilities, and railroads are also unreachable without p4. I am now listing exactly which properties from p4 each remaining color set requires.

I am now reconsidering the dark blue set. p2 is cash poor and might sell Boardwalk or Park Place for cash. I cannot pay fair value with only $279. A lowball offer would likely be rejected and could push p2 toward p4. Buying dark blue would also prevent p4 from inheriting it if p2 goes bankrupt.

I rejected the dark blue trade because it would drain my survival cash. I need at least $550 in liquid funds to survive a light blue hotel hit, and mortgaging everything to pay for Boardwalk would leave me broke.
